Elijah Wood | Elijah Jordan Wood (born January 28, 1981) is an American actor, voice actor, DJ, and producer.  He is best known for his high-profile leading role as Frodo Baggins in Peter Jackson's epic film trilogy "The Lord of the Rings" (2001–03).

Although he expects to have another boring summer, he encounters a dolphin whom he names Flipper and with whom he forms a friendship.
Afshin Zinoori | Afshin Zinoori (افشين زی‌نوری) (born April 30, 1976), is an Iranian actor who is known for Persian voice-dubbing foreign films and television programs.  He was originally born from Tehran.  He is known for dubbing over Elijah Wood's role as Frodo Baggins from "The Lord of the Rings" film trilogy and has also dubbed over some of Leonardo DiCaprio and Matt Damon's voice roles in films they starred in.  He has also dubbed over Daniel Radcliffe's role as Harry Potter, from the Harry Potter films 3-5.
Payton Haas | Payton Haas (born June 9, 1979) is an American actor who is most known for starring as Mike Blondel in the first season of "Flipper" , alongside Jessica Alba, Brian Wimmer, and Colleen Flynn.
Simian Records | Simian Records is a record label founded by actor and "The Lord of the Rings" star Elijah Wood in 2005.  The label's first album, "New Magnetic Wonder" by The Apples in Stereo, was released on February 6, 2007.  It was co-released and distributed through Yep Roc Records, Elephant 6 and Redeye Distribution.
Luke Halpin | Luke Austin Halpin (born April 4, 1947) is an American former actor.  Beginning a prolific career as a child actor at the age of eight, Halpin is perhaps best known for his role as Sandy Ricks in the feature films "Flipper" and "Flipper's New Adventure", as well as for reprising his role for the television series adaptation, also titled "Flipper".
